screen.aptitudes.title: Skills & Attributes
skill.aptitudes.mining.desc: Levels by mining stone and ores. Passives: faster mining and ARMOR.
skill.aptitudes.excavation.desc: Levels by digging. Passives: faster digging and KNOCKBACK RESISTANCE.
skill.aptitudes.woodcutting.desc: Levels by chopping logs. Passives: faster chopping and MAX HEALTH.
skill.aptitudes.farming.desc: Levels by harvesting. Passives: double harvest and LUCK.
skill.aptitudes.combat.desc: Levels by melee kills. Passive: more melee damage (%).
skill.aptitudes.archery.desc: Levels by projectile kills. Passive: more arrow damage.
skill.aptitudes.defense.desc: Levels by taking hits. Passives: ARMOR, TOUGHNESS and explosion resistance.
skill.aptitudes.agility.desc: Levels by sprinting. Passives: SPEED and safe fall.
aptitudes.allocations_reset: Your attribute points were refunded because your available points changed.
aptitudes.cmd.allocate_fail: Could not assign points (no points available or attribute at maximum).
aptitudes.cmd.respec_disabled: Respec is disabled on this server.
item.aptitudes.hitscan.tooltip: Right click: instant shot (%s mana). Scales with %s level.
item.aptitudes.herb_pouch.tooltip: Right click: heals and removes poison. Scales with Herbalist level.
item.aptitudes.wrench.tooltip: Right click a directional block: rotates it 90°.
role.aptitudes.berserker.desc: Axe warrior who gets deadlier the more wounded they are. XP: hitting with axes.
role.aptitudes.mage.desc: Large mana pool and ranged spells. XP: arcane staff and spells.
role.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Stealth, invisibility and backstabs. XP: hitting with the dagger.
role.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Healing, regeneration and poisons. XP: harvesting crops, flowers and berries; using herbs.
role.aptitudes.lancer.desc: Reach and devastating charges. XP: hitting with spear or trident.
role.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: Sword master: edge, parries and ripostes. XP: hitting with swords.
node.aptitudes.tough_skin.desc: +10% knockback resistance and +1 armor toughness per rank.
node.aptitudes.rage.desc: Strength and Speed for 8/10/12 s (Strength II at rank 3).
node.aptitudes.bloodlust.desc: Up to +15/30/45% melee damage based on missing health.
node.aptitudes.war_cry.desc: Knocks back, weakens and slows enemies within 5/6/7 blocks.
node.aptitudes.arcane_affinity.desc: +25 max mana and +0.5 regen per second, per rank.
node.aptitudes.fireball.desc: Fiery impact up to 24 blocks: 6/8/10 damage, sets on fire and splashes nearby enemies. Never burns blocks.
node.aptitudes.blink.desc: Teleports you up to 8/10/12 blocks where you look.
node.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Faster sneaking. From rank 2, invisible while sneaking.
node.aptitudes.vanish.desc: Invisibility and Speed for 6/8/10 s; mobs chasing you lose track.
node.aptitudes.shadow_step.desc: Teleports you behind the target you look at (16/20/24 blocks).
node.aptitudes.balm.desc: Heals 4/6/8 health and grants Regeneration to you and players within 6 blocks.
node.aptitudes.herbal_immunity.desc: Immune to poison (r1), hunger (r2) and wither (r3).
node.aptitudes.poison_thorns.desc: Poisons and slows enemies within 5/6/7 blocks.
node.aptitudes.engineering.desc: Per rank: +1 block interaction range, +10% break speed and +1 armor.
node.aptitudes.turret.desc: Deploys an allied iron golem for 20/25/30 s. Drops no iron.
node.aptitudes.battery.desc: Per rank: +25 max mana, +0.5 regen/s, higher jumps and +2 blocks of safe fall.
node.aptitudes.thrusters.desc: Boost forward and upward, with a short slow fall.
node.aptitudes.reach.desc: +0.5 blocks of attack reach per rank.
node.aptitudes.lunge.desc: Dash forward dealing 6/8/10 damage to enemies in your path.
node.aptitudes.sweep.desc: Circular strike: 5/7/9 damage to enemies around you.
node.aptitudes.blade_dance.desc: Haste I/II/III and Speed for 8/10/12 s.
node.aptitudes.parry.desc: 5/10/15% chance to negate a melee hit.
node.aptitudes.riposte.desc: For 2/3/4 s, the next hit you take is negated and returned at 150/200/250% damage.
screen.aptitudes.roles.title: Roles
screen.aptitudes.roles.inactive_hint: Pick this role as primary or secondary to use its tree.
aptitudes.role.tree_reset: Your %s tree points were refunded because the rules changed.
aptitudes.role.change_cooldown: You can change roles in %s min.
aptitudes.role.upgrade.role_not_active: That role is neither your primary nor your secondary.
aptitudes.role.upgrade.max_rank: That node is already at max rank.
aptitudes.role.upgrade.level_too_low: Your role level is too low for the next rank.
aptitudes.role.upgrade.no_points: No tree points left in that role.
aptitudes.ability.no_primary: You have no primary role. Press J to pick one.
aptitudes.ability.no_secondary: You have no secondary role. Press J to pick one.
aptitudes.ability.not_learned: You haven't learned that ability yet.
aptitudes.ability.no_effect: No target or room to use it.
aptitudes.cmd.role_same: That role already occupies that slot.
item.aptitudes.oak_staff.tooltip: Right click a block: fertilizes a 3×3 area (%s mana).
item.aptitudes.guild_seal.tooltip: Right click a villager: restocks its trades (Merchant only, 5 min cooldown).
item.aptitudes.guild_seal.not_merchant: Only an active Merchant can use the seal.
item.aptitudes.elemental_orb.tooltip: Right click: switch to the next mastered element (same as G).
role.aptitudes.engineer.desc: Practical and advanced tech combined: reach, plating, batteries, thrusters and turrets. XP: redstone, machines, wrench and plasma gun.
role.aptitudes.paladin.desc: Holy warrior: punishes the undead and protects allies. XP: holy hammer, damaging undead, blocking with a shield.
role.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Summons allied minions that grow with your level and drains life. Evolving unlocks blood arts: pay abilities with health, make enemies bleed and, as Crimson Progenitor, cheat death. XP: tome, drain and minion damage.
role.aptitudes.druid.desc: Forest guardian: growth, roots and bear form. XP: planting saplings, breeding animals, using the staff.
role.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Trade and cunning: discounts, extra profit and bribes. XP: trading with villagers.
role.aptitudes.monk.desc: Unarmed martial arts: iron fists, evasion and meditation. XP: hitting bare-handed.
role.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Masters up to 3 of 9 elements (at levels 1, 10 and 20). Abilities change with the active element (G key).
node.aptitudes.divine_shield.desc: Absorption I/II/III for 8 s and Resistance for 4/5/6 s.
node.aptitudes.protective_aura.desc: Resistance for you and players within 4/6/8 blocks. Rank 3 also grants Regeneration.
node.aptitudes.judgement.desc: Damages nearby enemies (6/8/10, double vs undead) and heals allies.
node.aptitudes.dark_pact.desc: Each creature dying within 16 blocks grants 2/4/6 mana and 1 health.
node.aptitudes.raise_minions.desc: Summons 1 zombie / zombie + skeleton / 2 zombies + skeleton allies for 45 s (max 4). They gain health, damage and armor with your level.
node.aptitudes.life_drain.desc: Heal 5/10/15% of the damage you or your minions deal.
node.aptitudes.death_touch.desc: Drains enemies within 5 blocks (4/5/6 damage + Wither) and heals you for half the total.
node.aptitudes.forest_child.desc: In forests, jungles and taigas: Speed; Regeneration from rank 2 and Strength at rank 3.
node.aptitudes.entangling_roots.desc: Roots and weakens enemies within 6/7/8 blocks for 3/4/5 s.
node.aptitudes.growth.desc: Every 2 s nearby crops and saplings grow on their own (more radius and chance per rank).
node.aptitudes.bear_form.desc: For 10/12/14 s: Strength, Resistance and Health Boost, but slower. Heals on transforming.
node.aptitudes.haggling.desc: Permanent Hero of the Village I/II/III: villager discounts.
node.aptitudes.appraiser_eye.desc: Luck I/II/III for 60 s and reveals nearby creatures for 10 s.
node.aptitudes.deep_pockets.desc: 10/20/30% chance of an extra emerald on each trade.
node.aptitudes.bribe.desc: Costs 1 emerald. Enemies within 8/10/12 blocks stop attacking players for 7/9/11 s.
node.aptitudes.chi_palm.desc: Strike up to 5 blocks: 6/8/10 damage and a big knockback.
node.aptitudes.evasion.desc: 7/14/21% chance to avoid any attack from a creature.
node.aptitudes.meditation.desc: 4 s still: Regeneration III and Resistance II. Restores 30/40/50 mana. Costs no mana.
node.aptitudes.elemental_affinity.desc: Enables the passive of your active element; its strength depends on rank.
node.aptitudes.elemental_bolt.desc: Strike up to 24 blocks (6/7/8 damage) with the active element's effect.
node.aptitudes.elemental_dominion.desc: Your other mastered elements' passives are also active, at this rank.
node.aptitudes.elemental_burst.desc: Blast within 5/6/7 blocks with the active element's effect.
element.aptitudes.ice.desc: Slows and freezes. Passive: immune to freezing (powder snow).
element.aptitudes.lightning.desc: Chain damage and lightning. Passive: +3% speed per rank.
element.aptitudes.earth.desc: Launches enemies into the air. Passive: +1 armor per rank.
element.aptitudes.wind.desc: Strong knockback and levitation. Passive: +3 blocks safe fall per rank.
element.aptitudes.water.desc: Healing damage and area heals. Passive: water breathing (and fast swimming from rank 2).
element.aptitudes.plant.desc: Poison and roots. Passive: regenerate on dirt, grass or leaves.
element.aptitudes.magma.desc: Heavy fire damage with knockback. Passive: immune to magma blocks, +1 toughness per rank.
element.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Wither, blindness and invisibility. Passive: night vision in the dark.
aptitudes.element.not_elementalist: Elementalist must be your primary or secondary role.
aptitudes.element.no_slot: You can't master another element yet (levels 1, 10 and 20).
ultimate.aptitudes.berserker.desc: 8 s unable to die (health never drops below 1), with Strength II, Speed II and Resistance.
ultimate.aptitudes.mage.desc: A black hole at the target point pulls and damages enemies for 5 s.
ultimate.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Leap behind up to 5 nearby enemies; those below 30% health die instantly.
ultimate.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: 8-block zone for 10 s: allies regenerate and are cleansed; enemies are poisoned.
ultimate.aptitudes.engineer.desc: 12 impacts in 3 s around the target point. They don't break blocks, but hurt everything they hit.
ultimate.aptitudes.lancer.desc: Huge leap and dive with a devastating shockwave.
ultimate.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: 15 slashes in 3 s on the nearest enemy, ignoring hit invulnerability.
ultimate.aptitudes.paladin.desc: 8-block zone for 8 s: allies cannot die and undead burn.
ultimate.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Drains enemies within 10 blocks, heals you, fills your minion army and enrages it.
ultimate.aptitudes.druid.desc: Summons 3 allied spirit wolves (30 s) and roots nearby enemies.
ultimate.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Roulette: jackpot, power, full heal, gold rain, curse on enemies… or the house wins.
ultimate.aptitudes.monk.desc: 10 s untouchable by creatures, with Speed III, Strength II and Jump Boost.
ultimate.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Unleash the burst of all your mastered elements at once.
screen.aptitudes.evolve.maxed: This role has reached its ultimate form.
screen.aptitudes.evolve.boss: Defeat the Wither, the Dragon or the Warden with this role active
aptitudes.evolve.role_not_active: You can only evolve your primary or secondary role.
aptitudes.evolve.max_tier: This role is already in its ultimate form.
aptitudes.evolve.level_too_low: Your role level is too low to evolve.
aptitudes.evolve.trial_incomplete: You haven't completed the mastery trial yet.
aptitudes.evolve.no_boss: You must defeat a boss (Wither, Dragon or Warden) with this role active.
aptitudes.evolve.missing_item: You need the evolution item in your inventory.
aptitudes.ability.no_ultimate: You need a role in its Ultimate form to use an ultimate ability.
aptitudes.ability.no_blood: Not enough health for blood magic (costs %s).
aptitudes.blood.immortality: Crimson Immortality! Blood denies you death.
aptitudes.casino.jackpot: 🎰 JACKPOT! Emeralds, Luck and Hero of the Village.
aptitudes.casino.curse: 🎰 Bad luck falls upon your enemies.
category.aptitudes.martial.desc: Melee combat: Berserker, Lancer, Swordsman and Monk.
category.aptitudes.arcane.desc: Magic and dark powers: Mage, Necromancer and Elementalist.
category.aptitudes.shadow.desc: Stealth and deception: Assassin and Shapeshifter.
category.aptitudes.guardian.desc: Protection and life: Herbalist, Paladin and Druid.
category.aptitudes.craft.desc: Ingenuity and trade: Engineer and Merchant.
role.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Turns into mobs (unlocked by defeating them) and uses their powers. Other players see you as the mob. XP: using transformations and powers.
ultimate.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Become a Warden for 20 s: +20 health, Strength II, Resistance II, Darkness to nearby players and Sonic Boom as your power.
node.aptitudes.mimicry.desc: Reduces mana drain while transformed (3 → 2.5 → 2 → 1.5 per second).
node.aptitudes.transform.desc: Turns you into the chosen form (or back to human). Others see you as the mob; your hitbox doesn't change.
node.aptitudes.trickster.desc: R1: monsters ignore you while you look like one of them. R2: you emit the mob's sounds (other players hear them too).
node.aptitudes.form_power.desc: Uses the current form's power: explosion (Creeper), teleport (Enderman), venom bite (Spider), fireballs (Blaze), flight (Bat), super jump (Slime), egg barrage (Chicken), ground slam (Golem), curse (Witch), escape (Villager).
form.aptitudes.creeper.desc: Power: explode without dying (breaks blocks if the server allows). Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.enderman.desc: Night vision. Power: 20-28 block teleport. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.spider.desc: Night vision. Power: venom bite. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.blaze.desc: Fire resistance. Power: 3 fireballs. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.bat.desc: Night vision; slow fall while sneaking. Power: short flight. Unlock: defeat 5.
form.aptitudes.slime.desc: No fall damage. Power: super jump. Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.chicken.desc: Slow fall. Power: egg barrage (troll). Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.iron_golem.desc: Resistance, but slower. Power: ground slam. Unlock: defeat 3.
form.aptitudes.witch.desc: Poison immune. Power: curse (poison, slowness, weakness). Unlock: defeat 10.
form.aptitudes.villager.desc: Perfect troll disguise. Power: escape (Speed III). Unlock: Shapeshifter level 5.
item.aptitudes.mimic_mask.tooltip: Right click: transform / return to human form (Shapeshifter).
item.aptitudes.mimic_mask.not_shapeshift: You need the Shapeshifter role active.
aptitudes.morph.locked: You haven't unlocked the %s form yet.
aptitudes.morph.exhausted: Out of mana: you return to human form.
signature.aptitudes.berserker.desc: Mobs within 8 blocks lose HALF their current health; you gain Strength III and Speed II (15 s).
signature.aptitudes.mage.desc: 8 explosive impacts at the target point (no block damage).
signature.aptitudes.assassin.desc: Marks the target: it takes TRIPLE damage from you for 10 s.
signature.aptitudes.herbalist.desc: Cleanses nearby allies and grants Regeneration III and extra health.
signature.aptitudes.engineer.desc: 1st use: sets a teleport point. 2nd use: return to it with plating (Absorption IV + Resistance II).
signature.aptitudes.lancer.desc: 3 s of continuous charges that trample enemies; untouchable by creatures meanwhile.
signature.aptitudes.swordsman.desc: A 14-block slash through every enemy: 20 damage.
signature.aptitudes.paladin.desc: 10 s taking NO damage at all, +50 mana, Health Boost III, Absorption III, Resistance II and a full heal.
signature.aptitudes.necromancer.desc: Raises 4 minions with Strength II and Resistance II. Passive (Master): your minions are sturdier and their damage heals you.
signature.aptitudes.druid.desc: When you die, you revive as with a Totem of Undying. Once every 5 minutes.
signature.aptitudes.merchant.desc: Permanent Hero of the Village V (huge discounts) and Luck.
signature.aptitudes.monk.desc: Fully heals allies within 10 blocks and grants Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II and Regeneration II (20 s).
signature.aptitudes.elementalist.desc: Raises a wall of your main element and unleashes its domain for 10 s, damaging every enemy inside.
signature.aptitudes.shapeshifter.desc: Troll: turns nearby players into chickens for 10 s and levitates monsters.
aptitudes.ability.no_signature: You need a Master-tier role (with an active signature) to use Z.
aptitudes.signature.beacon_set: Beacon set. Use the ability again to return here.
aptitudes.signature.forest_rebirth: The forest brings you back to life!
unique.aptitudes.adaptation.desc: Passive: each hit of the same damage type makes you 10% more resistant to it for 60 s (max 80%). Active: 10 s immunity to the last damage type taken and Regeneration II.
unique.aptitudes.greed.desc: Passive: 15% extra emerald on kills. Active: steals every beneficial effect from anyone within 8 blocks.
unique.aptitudes.void_archive.desc: Passive: memorizes the last role ability used near you (16 blocks) by any player. Active: you cast it yourself at rank 3.
unique.aptitudes.fungal.desc: Passive: your hits infect (poison) and it spreads on death. Active: 6 s spore cloud (poison II, blindness).
unique.aptitudes.parasite.desc: Passive: 10% lifesteal. Active: latch onto a target, draining 2 health per second for 5 s while invisible.
unique.aptitudes.hellfire.desc: Passive: fire immune; your hits burn. Active: infernal nova (10 area damage and ground fire).
unique.aptitudes.chosen_king.desc: Passive: +4 hearts; Strength and Regeneration to allies within 12 blocks. Active: Royal Decree (enemies within 16 blocks are nearly frozen and weakened).
unique.aptitudes.chosen_king.condition: Defeat the Wither and the Dragon: %s/%s
unique.aptitudes.spacetime.desc: Passive: your position and health are recorded every second. Active: rewind 5 seconds (position and health).
unique.aptitudes.negation.desc: Passive: immune to negative effects. Active: 8 s zone where other players CANNOT use abilities and mobs lose their effects.
unique.aptitudes.geneticist.desc: Passive: nearby babies grow 10× faster. Active: mutates nearby animals into other species.
unique.aptitudes.mirror.desc: Active: copy the mob you look at (any mob): become it for 30 s and gain half its max health.
unique.aptitudes.exploiter.desc: Passive: 25% double ore. Active: 15 s of double loot from creatures you kill and Luck III.
unique.aptitudes.pendragon.desc: Passive: with a sword, +4 armor and +10% damage. Active: Excalibur, a 30-block beam of light (16 damage, double vs undead).
unique.aptitudes.sky_lord.desc: Passive: immune to fall damage. Active: 12 s of free flight.
unique.aptitudes.stillness.desc: Passive: Resistance while crouching still. Active: stops time for 5 s within 12 blocks (mobs and projectiles frozen).
unique.aptitudes.harbinger.desc: Passive: undead won't attack you. Active: sentence a target; after 3 s it loses 50% of its max health (10% for bosses).
aptitudes.unique.granted: ✦ %s has obtained the unique ability %s. No one else can have it!

aptitudes.unique.none: You have no unique ability (press U to see the feats).

attribute.aptitudes.mind.desc: Increases max mana and its regeneration.
attribute.aptitudes.intelligence.desc: Increases spell, explosion and ranged ability damage.
attribute.aptitudes.faith.desc: Reduces the cooldown of all your abilities.

aptitudes.souls.rested: You rest at the Bonfire. Health and mana restored; respawn point set.
aptitudes.souls.need_bonfire: You must be next to the Bonfire you rested at.
aptitudes.souls.leveled: Soul level %s (−%s XP levels). Every 3 soul levels = 1 attribute point.
aptitudes.souls.stain_left: Your XP (%s points) remains where you fell: %s, %s, %s. Recover it before dying again.

node.aptitudes.berserker_a1.desc: Lifesteal: +2% per rank (max +6%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.berserker_a2.desc: Critical hit (×1.5): +4% per rank (max +12%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.berserker_a3.desc: Execute (+damage vs enemies under 35% health): +6% per rank (max +18%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.berserker_b1.desc: Thorns (reflects melee damage): +6% per rank (max +18%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.berserker_b2.desc: Knockback resistance: +6% per rank (max +18%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.berserker_b3.desc: Damage reduction: +3% per rank (max +9%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.mage_a1.desc: Critical hit (×1.5): +4% per rank (max +12%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.mage_a2.desc: Chance to burn: +8% per rank (max +24%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.mage_a3.desc: Execute (+damage vs enemies under 35% health): +6% per rank (max +18%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.mage_b1.desc: Mana regeneration (per second): +0.4 per rank (max +1.2). Choosing this path locks the other one.
node.aptitudes.mage_b2.desc: Role resource gain: +12% per rank (max +36%). Choosing this path locks the other one.
